summary: Added a seam regression proving Vault discounted protocol fee dust can be flushed from CapsuleHub into a real FeeAccumulator.
covered_flow: Vault user ATH balance is set to ATH_FULL_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT - 1 through the official Vault ATH wallet notification path.
Vault external private publish computes a discounted protocol fee of 1 nanotON.
CapsuleHub accepts the Vault publish and accrues 1 nanotON.
CapsuleHub FlushFees(1) succeeds because the whole accrued bucket is being flushed.
A real FeeAccumulator receives and accounts the 1 nanotON principal.

verification.focused_tests: npm.cmd run test:file -- tests\vault-m6-publish.test.ts tests\vault-prune-pending-publish.test.ts tests\capsulehub-boundary-negative.test.ts tests\capsulehub.test.ts

production_note: No contract bytecode changed in this milestone. The implemented-subset manifest remains non-final until mainnet route, funding, address, and final-genesis evidence blockers are closed.
